capabilities: Chat with AI models from multiple providers using user-supplied API keys
Search vault notes with tag, frontmatter, folder, time, and regex filters
Create, append to, and edit notes through model-invoked Markdown write tools
Attach notes, images, and DOCX/PPTX/XLSX files, with local text extraction
Generate and save images via an optional image-generation tool
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community plugin catalog, so it must be installed manually from a build. Provider requests may incur usage charges billed by the model provider. Detailed limitations (no conversation persistence, no PDF/OCR extraction, no whole-note overwrite or delete) and DESIGN.md/ROADMAP.md documents are listed in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to let an AI model query vault content and create or edit notes through tool calls.

requires.name: Azure Foundry, Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Google, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter
Provider API key stored in Obsidian SecretStorage

summary: Chat assistant that connects to user-configured AI providers to search, read, and edit Markdown notes, with attachments and image generation.
